payload.title: Calls B — call schema + CallCommand/CallCommandResult gateway routing
payload.description: Port call-schema.ts (CallRoom/CallInvite/CallParticipant objects, Call* events/streams, WebRTCSignal, build_call_schema()) and route the CallCommand frame (kind 21) through the gateway to a control-plane handler replying CallCommandResult (kind 22). Frames already exist in crates/frick-protocol. Plan phase B.
